title: (review) Wave-3 batch codereview pending: rangetest observe gate, slot-coord fixes, group_oscore epochs, oscore fallback
description: Per the beads-worker loop, wave-3 changes need the 3-perspective batch review (correctness/security/robustness) before sign-off. Findings -> bd create. Note: agents self-verified with negative tests where cheap (ir24 #error proven live, wmf0 both configs, twister 13/13 + 6/6 + 20/20, pytest 19+161+6 suites).
